Place Title and Description in Header, main content in Content, and controls in Footer. Use Action for a header-level control.

## Usage

```ts
import { card, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/card';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/card`. It [registers](../../registration/) 7 components for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `card` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "report",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Card.Root",
    "slots": {
      "default": [
        {
          "id": "header",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Card.Header",
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "title",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Card.Title",
                "inputs": {
                  "text": "Weekly report"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "summary",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Card.Content",
          "inputs": {
            "text": "Three reports completed"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

The card shows “Weekly report” above its summary.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-card-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Card.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Card`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"default" \| "sm"` | Default `"default"` |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `null \| string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

<details>
<summary>Additional HTML and ARIA inputs</summary>

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `null \| string` |  |
| `data-disabled` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-icon` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-invalid` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `role` | `string` |  |
| `style` | `string` |  |

This part also supports the [listed shared inputs](../../attributes/#attributes-c337cc7871).

</details>

Slots `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
